nodes.label: Multi-Variant Move Calculation Pattern
nodes.rationale: baseMove() dispatches piece movement to variant-specific update functions (owareUpdatePiecesFromMove, togyzkumalakUpdatePiecesFromMove, backgammonUpdatePiecesFromMove, dameoUpdatePiecesFromMove) rather than always doing a simple piece swap, enabling correct game rules for each variant while keeping a single entry point.

nodes.label: State Function Delegation Pattern
nodes.rationale: HeadlessState stores function references (baseMove, premove, render, processDrag, etc.) rather than calling modules directly, enabling variants and tests to override behavior via the state object without changing call sites.

nodes.label: DOM Element Reuse Pattern
nodes.rationale: render() reuses existing DOM piece/square elements by moving them rather than destroying and recreating them on every board update, minimizing DOM mutations for performance.
